messages:
Megan (Prod Marketing): morning — FYI I pulled the weekly KPI board and there's a weird spike in 'webinar landing -> demo signups' conversion yesterday at ~14:00 UTC. not sure if it's legit or an attribution issue :thinking_face:
Ravi (Growth): saw that too. raw clicks are also up but UTM 'campaign' tags look inconsistent on a subset of sessions — some have ?utm_campaign=redwood_launch, others have campaign=redwood_launch (no utm_). think the ingestion rules might be dropping those as unknowns.
Asha (Analytics): copying the query I ran:
```
SELECT event_date, count(*) as leads
FROM web_events
WHERE path = '/webinar-2026' AND (utm_campaign = 'redwood_launch' OR campaign = 'redwood_launch')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date DESC
LIMIT 7;
```
Asha (Analytics): result shows 14:00 UTC spike comes from traffic with `campaign` (no utm_) that our ETL maps to `source=unknown` currently.
Diego (Events): that matches a batch we pushed from Hopin yesterday — I asked their export team to use our canonical utm_ keys but looks like the template they used had `campaign` instead. ugh.
Kara (PMM): is that why webinar benchmark narrative looks 20% better? we were about to ship the launch post referencing 'record demo signups' — should we pause? :grimacing:
Megan (Prod Marketing): yes hold the claims. can we present both 'as-reported' and 'normalised' numbers in the narrative? normalised = map `campaign` -> `utm_campaign` and de-dupe via session id.
Asha (Analytics): I can produce a small normalization layer and a compare table. will need ~2 hours to re-run the dashboard panels and update the cohort breakdown.
Ravi (Growth): for the immediate KPI snapshot, could we add a quick fallback rule in the dashboard SQL: `COALESCE(utm_campaign, campaign)` so visualizations show combined counts until ETL is fixed?
Asha (Analytics): yep that's what I'll push to staging. quick patch snippet: `SELECT COALESCE(meta->>'utm_campaign', meta->>'campaign') as campaign_key`
MarketingBot: deploy status: dashboard-staging update queued by Asha at 1756789250 — check /deploys/dashboard for logs.
Megan (Prod Marketing): thanks. Diego — can you get Hopin to regenerate the CSV with proper utm_ fields and ping @Ravi when done? we need clean source attribution for the post.
Diego (Events): on it. pinged their ops, ETA 4 hours. will attach new export once available.
Kara (PMM): separate ask — webinar feedback loop: are we confident the attendees we mark as 'trial-ready' match the demo signups metric? want to avoid double-counting in the narrative.
Asha (Analytics): good call. the mapping is: webinar_attendee_id -> session_id -> lead_id. the only gap is ~3% where session_id is null. I'll add a small table showing the unlink rate and exclude those from the 'trial-ready' claim.
Ravi (Growth): long-term: let's add a validation alert (1% threshold) if COALESCE(utm_campaign, campaign) / total_campaign_hits drops below 0.98 — catch downstream template issues earlier.
Megan (Prod Marketing): agreed. add that to the post-launch checklist. For the immediate tasks: 1) Asha normalize + update dashboard (staging) 2) Ravi add quick COALESCE patch to KPI snapshot 3) Diego get Hopin export 4) Kara hold public narrative until we have both raw and normalized numbers.
Asha (Analytics): started the re-run — will post updated panels link here.
MarketingBot: deploy status: dashboard-staging update succeeded at 1756789350 — panels refreshed.
Megan (Prod Marketing): sharing internal note for PR: "we observed a campaign-tagging discrepancy affecting webinar attribution; normalized metrics will be published alongside raw figures to maintain transparency." please keep comments short so comms can finalize the launch post.
Diego (Events): Hopin provided corrected export and I've uploaded to /shared/events/exports/hopin-webinar-1756789012.csv — Ravi can you confirm mapping?
Ravi (Growth): grabbing it now. mapping looks clean. after normalize the uplift goes from +22% to +6% vs baseline. that's still positive but no longer a "record" spike.
Kara (PMM): ok that's helpful. We'll reword: "strong webinar performance with 6% uplift in demo signups vs baseline (normalized); raw reporting showed 22% due to campaign-tag mismatch."
Megan (Prod Marketing): perfect. Asha — can you paste the final chart images (normalized vs raw) so comms can embed?
Asha (Analytics): attaching links to staging images: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/panels/1756/normalized.png and https://dashboards.redwood.internal/panels/1756/raw.png
Megan (Prod Marketing): thanks — we're unblocking the launch post. final note: add a tiny line to the postmortem checklist to confirm 3rd-party export templates use canonical utm_ keys before any promotion. saved us from an overclaim. :white_check_mark: 
Ravi (Growth): adding alert ticket in backlog: MGMT-3125 (utm key validation).
Diego (Events): will run a quick QA on the Hopin template and share a check script.
Kara (PMM): I'm updating the narrative and will circulate for a quick approval in #marketing-review in 30m.
Megan (Prod Marketing): excellent team — closing this thread when the PR goes live. thanks all. :tada:
